اغتصبتم (form VIII)
# اِغْتَصَبْتُمْ (iḡtaṣabtum) /iɣ.ta.sˤab.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# اُغْتُصِبْتُمْ (uḡtuṣibtum) /uɣ.tu.sˤib.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
